params.text:
I have successfully identified all opened issues that ask about OPT model related questions in the metaseq GitLab project. Here is the complete list:

1. #5 - How much gpu memory needed for opt-175B fine-tuning?
2. #7 - OPT-IML Bench release?
3. #12 - Code for OPT-IML Bench?
4. #16 - Import a Megatron-LM or HuggingFace OPT/GPT2 model file(s)
5. #26 - How to load an OPT-IML checkpoint and use it for inference?
6. #39 - Error when run reshard_fsdp on opt-IML 30b for inference
7. #44 - How to prevent duplicate output? Repeated sentences? I want to generate longer texts
8. #54 - Can not load OPT-175B model.
9. #75 - convert_to_singleton seems to hang for OPT-66B
10. #83 - Train and release OPT-350m with layer norm
11. #86 - No longer able to load provided OPT checkpoint after recent changes
12. #96 - OPT Can Generate Human-level Text With Contrastive Search
13. #131 - How to load pretrained weight in finetuning?
14. #144 - OPT Results not matching for HellaSWAG dataset
15. #159 - Running OPT 175B with different hardware configurations
16. #165 - Convert opt to megatron-lm
17. #167 - DGX 2 with 16 V100
18. #178 - Fine-tune OPT with my own dataset
19. #183 - Add OPT to huggingface conversion guidelines/scripts
20. #188 - assert key_padding_mask.size(1) == src_len in 350M model

These 20 issues were identified from the 95 total open issues in the metaseq project. All issues are currently open and contain questions specifically about OPT models, including OPT-175B, OPT-IML, OPT-66B, OPT-350m, and other OPT variants. The questions cover topics such as GPU memory requirements, model loading, fine-tuning, inference, hardware configurations, and conversion between different model formats.
